name: JavaScript III — Advanced ES6+, Async & OOP Engine
description: Master closures, prototypes, ES6 classes, async/await, custom EventEmitters, and build an Interactive Expense Tracker App.
whatYouLearn: Encapsulate private state using lexical closures
Master OOP classes and prototype inheritance
Handle async workflows with async/await and Promises
Build an Interactive Expense Tracker Capstone
prerequisites: JavaScript II — DOM Manipulation & Browser APIs
